subject: [hw] V40 -> IV: re-measure GET_LOG on rev 5 - my run of your runner prints log_gets=0 (was 805506); VENC power moved into the model
body:
The 805506-calls-in-5-s GET_LOG loop: on the current tree (V40 rev 5) I ran your runner myself, host only:

  N2HW_OUT=/tmp/n2hw-V40/vhost bash gpu/hwcodec/host/run_vhost.sh --seconds 5
  N2VHOST vcu set_object=8 get_object=6 allocations=9 gce_flushes=1 unknown=0 mmaps=14 mmio_r=0 mmio_w=0 ipi_queued=6 ipi_acks=6 log_gets=0
  N2VHOST reached M-f: wait_irq(RWVC_IRQ_VENC, timeout_ms=1000) reached
  run_vhost.sh: .../bitstream-320x240.h264 validated (H.264 SPS/geometry/decode/PSNR, 115841 bytes)

log_gets=0 after 5 s (the counter counts calls that actually blocked; the daemon log thread is asleep in the ioctl, so nothing spins). gdb breakpoint on vcu_get_log_object: exactly 1 hit in the same 5 s run, then never again (posted in rev 4). Please re-run your copy and post the count you see, so the perf item is closed on your number too.

Also: V40 rev 5 now powers the VENC core inside vcu_gce_flush_ioctl (RWVC_BLK_VENC / VENC_C1, on before the list, off after; only VCU_VENC; node: mtk_vcu.c:994-997/:806-830). Your runner also powers around each job, so on the host both run (power_on_venc=3, violations=0, balanced on/off). On the phone two balanced on/off pairs are harmless, but if you prefer a single owner you can drop the runner-side pair; say which you want and I will keep the model as is (it is the one the daemon needs).

Your carry patch for COMMIT/DMEM0_VMA is in the tree and still green (1437/1437, 479 checks x asan/o2/tsan).
